description.label: Description
description.value:
Your body turns into something of chaotic and otherworldly anatomy and appearance.

  • Arms: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mDgEMOoJpi8DkRYb]{Magical}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.v3uzEthcq0JRar0J]{Daemonic} (10). Pick one: +1 AP, @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.HCvKEsrNVqyJIIxP]{Razor-sharp Claws}, or +10 Strength.
  • Legs: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mDgEMOoJpi8DkRYb]{Magical}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.v3uzEthcq0JRar0J]{Daemonic} (10). Pick one: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.CV9btQn09S9Fn8Jk]{Strong Legs}, +1 Movement, or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.qZ4cFy6z482ZONuA]{Sturdy}.
  • Body: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mDgEMOoJpi8DkRYb]{Magical}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.v3uzEthcq0JRar0J]{Daemonic} (9+) (replaces other @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.v3uzEthcq0JRar0J]{Daemonic} scores), +10 Toughness, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.pTorrE0l3VybAbtn]{Fear} 2 (replaces lower @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.pTorrE0l3VybAbtn]{Fear} scores).
  • Head: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.mDgEMOoJpi8DkRYb]{Magical}, @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.v3uzEthcq0JRar0J]{Daemonic} (10), @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.pTorrE0l3VybAbtn]{Fear} 1. Pick one: @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.x0WMGwuQzReXcQrs]{Night Vision}, @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.5V5B3xILSelJ8rXk]{Fangs}, or @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.oa1XVd4fxpW3vr84]{Horns}.
